product: Marketed products include Dupixent (dupilumab), EYLEA HD and EYLEA, Libtayo (cemiplimab), Praluent, Evkeeza, Lynozyfic and newly approved Pasatru for FOP. Roughly 50 clinical assets span allergy and inflammation, ophthalmology, oncology, cardiovascular and metabolic, neurology and rare disease.
demand: Demand is robust for growth drivers: Q2 2026 Dupixent global sales 6.0B usd up 38 pct, EYLEA HD US 596M usd up 52 pct and Libtayo global 489M usd up 30 pct, all records, offset by declining legacy EYLEA.
pricing_power: Limited and negative on price: management attributes EYLEA HD and EYLEA gains to volumes but cites lower net selling prices, and EYLEA US fell 45 pct. Pricing power appears weak in ophthalmology and contested categories despite new indications.
competition: Intense: EYLEA faces Vabysmo from Roche and EYLEA biosimilars, Libtayo and fianlimab face Keytruda from Merck, cemdisiran faces Vyvgart from argenx and C5 inhibitors, and olatorepatide enters a crowded obesity market led by Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly.
team: Founded and led by physician-scientists; Leonard S. Schleifer is Board co-Chair, President and CEO, and Christopher Fenimore is Executive Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer. Management emphasizes roughly 50 clinical assets and the homegrown VelociSuite antibody platforms.
market_strategy: Expand Dupixent across indications, transition ophthalmology to EYLEA HD, grow oncology and rare disease, invest in US manufacturing at Saratoga Springs, pursue external innovation such as the Telix radiopharma and Parabilis deals, and return capital through buybacks of 2.0B usd in H1 2026 plus dividends.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue 4.291B up 17 pct, Dupixent global 6.0B up 38 pct, EYLEA HD US up 52 pct, Sanofi balance repaid lifting Q3 collaboration profits, Pasatru FDA approved 2026-08-19, cemdisiran PDUFA Nov 2026.
bear: EYLEA US fell 45 pct on biosimilars and price; GAAP net income fell 7 pct, gross margin 78 pct; fianlimab Phase 3 missed PFS May 2026; securities class action lead-plaintiff deadline 2026-09-14; several targets below spot.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-30 showing EYLEA US net sales down more than 45 pct year over year or a GAAP EPS miss versus Q2 2026.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 results 2026-07-30: revenue 4.291B usd up 17 pct, non-GAAP EPS 14.29 up 11 pct, and the Sanofi Development Balance fully repaid, lifting collaboration profits from Q3 2026. FDA approved Pasatru (garetosmab) for FOP on 2026-08-19. Cemdisiran gMG NDA accepted under priority review 2026-06-22. FY26 gross-margin guidance raised. Q3 2026 date set 2026-09-24.
web_not_known_yesterday: not found. No company event dated 2026-09-25 was located; the newest material items are 2026-09-24, namely the Q3 2026 earnings-date announcement and RBC Capital maintaining Hold with a 737 usd target.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Volume and demand led: EYLEA HD US up 52 pct, Libtayo global up 30 pct and Dupixent global up 38 pct on higher demand, partly offset by lower net selling prices. EYLEA US fell 45 pct on lower volume plus lower price. Growth is mix-shifted toward EYLEA HD and Dupixent.
web_suppliers: Manufacturing is largely in-house across US sites plus Limerick Ireland, with Saratoga Springs NY under construction. Licensors and partners include Alnylam for cemdisiran, Hansoh for olatorepatide, Telix for radiopharma and Parabilis. A Limerick bulk-manufacturing interruption cut Q2 GAAP gross margin to 78 pct via unabsorbed costs, now resolved.
web_customers: Highly concentrated on Sanofi: Q2 2026 Sanofi collaboration revenue was 2,174M usd or 51 pct of total, driven by Dupixent, whose global sales Sanofi records. Bayer contributed 276M usd, down 33 pct. End demand flows through payers, specialty pharmacies and distributors.
web_who_loses: Roche and Genentech (Vabysmo competes with EYLEA), Amgen (EYLEA biosimilars), argenx (Vyvgart) and AstraZeneca/Alexion (C5 drugs) against cemdisiran in gMG, Merck (Keytruda) against Libtayo and fianlimab, and obesity incumbents Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly as olatorepatide advances.
web_contradicting_evidence: EYLEA US net sales fell 45 pct and the EYLEA franchise 12 pct on biosimilars and price erosion. GAAP net income fell 7 pct and GAAP gross margin dropped to 78 pct. Fianlimab Phase 3 missed PFS versus pembrolizumab in May 2026. A securities class action over fianlimab and Libtayo trial statements had a 2026-09-14 lead-plaintiff deadline. Several analyst targets sit below spot.
web_if_management_right: Dupixent, Libtayo and EYLEA HD sustain double-digit growth, the Sanofi Development Balance repayment lifts collaboration profits from Q3 2026, cemdisiran wins FDA approval around November 2026 as the first siRNA for gMG, Pasatru ramps in FOP, and raised guidance drives the stock toward the 900 to 1,030 usd target range.
web_if_management_wrong: EYLEA franchise erosion accelerates as biosimilars and Vabysmo take share, Dupixent growth slows on new competition, and pipeline setbacks continue after fianlimab. Gross margin breaks first, then the expected collaboration-profit step-up is swamped by price erosion and legal costs, producing an EPS miss.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Sanofi via the Dupixent profit split and booked sales, Alnylam via cemdisiran royalties, Telix via radiopharma milestones, Hansoh via olatorepatide, Bayer via EYLEA ex-US, plus contract manufacturers and CDMOs supporting US and Ireland plants and specialty distributors and pharmacies.
